Waiting on you

Questions only the user can answer — a look, a listen, an approval, a decision — and their verdicts.

A gate is a question the work can't settle by itself: an in-person check, a listening pass, an A/B choice, an approval, a decision. Each is one record; everything else refers to it by ID rather than restating it. Answered and dropped gates move to the archive, verdicts and all.

## G04. The question, as the user will read it
Status: waiting · Asked: YYYY-MM-DD · For: B03 · Needs: what must be true to answer it

Setup: exactly what to look at or run, and how.
Passes if: what a "yes" looks like.
Evidence: paths to the build, render, demo or log.

### Verdicts

- YYYY-MM-DD — "the user's words, verbatim" — pass / fail / unclear. Checked: preconditions.

Status (waiting, answered, dropped) and Asked are required. To retract a verdict, add a new dated line saying what is withdrawn and set the gate back to waiting; never edit an old verdict.

G02. Does the manual (non-plugin) install work in a real session?

Status: waiting · Asked: 2026-10-05 · Needs: Plugin NOT loaded with --plugin-dir; no other pastey hook registered

Setup: from the repo run uv run scripts/pastey_install.py install --project <a scratch project>, then start claude in that project (restart if it was already open) in manual or accept edits mode. Ask Claude to write a short spec under docs/ and to give you an SQL query to copy. Then run uv run scripts/pastey_install.py uninstall --project <same project>. Passes if: the spec and the numbered snippets/NNNN-*.sql open in VS Code with no plugin loaded; status shows hook and skill installed before uninstall; after uninstall, .claude/settings.json holds only what it held before and a new write does not open. Evidence: <project>/.claude/settings.json, settings.json.pastey.bak, %TEMP%\pastey\pastey.log.
